pages.text: Potion Table: brew samples with purity ≥25 into potions; the product $(reset)inherits the sample's purity and creature source$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Genotype value$(reset): samples come from a concrete creature (zombie, pig, Ender Dragon...); the potion brews that creature's $(reset)genotype$(reset).$(br2)View the current body state at the Gene Manager: $(reset)each genotype can be absorbed once, up to 4 total$(reset) — plan before brewing to avoid wasting high-purity samples.

pages.title: Permanent Potion (absorption)
pages.text: $(bold)Recipe:$(reset) 3 Solid Matter + 20,000 life energy, 60 ticks.$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(reset) writes the genotype into your body; $(reset)effective compatibility of ALL organs of that source +N$(reset).$(br2)$(bold)Purity tiers:$(reset)$(li)Purity 1-20 → +3$(li)21-40 → +6$(li)41-60 → +9$(li)61-80 → +12$(li)81-100 → +15$(br2)$(bold)Rules:$(reset) one absorption per source per lifetime; cap 4 sources; uninstall at the Gene Manager to re-absorb. Compatibility scales organ output directly — absorbing high-purity genes is the foundation of a build.

pages.title: Breakthrough Potion (awakening)
pages.text: $(bold)Shared prerequisites:$(reset)$(li)That source's genotype already absorbed via permanent potion$(li)At least 1 $(reset)non-native$(reset) organ of that source transplanted (native doesn't count)$(br2)$(bold)Effect:$(reset) organs of that source get a temporary boost for the mode's duration —$(li)Extra compatibility +2 to +8 (four purity tiers)$(li)Base stats amplified by the mode's percentage$(li)$(reset)Negative-base traits are suspended while active$(reset)$(br2)$(bold)Only 1 breakthrough active at a time$(reset); re-activate after expiry/uninstall. Breakthrough stacks with ecosystem synergy.
Recipes and the three modes (Balance / Surge / Endure) are on the next page. For reading a whole-build boost, see Ecosystem Synergy. Rejection and gene-slot management live under Sequences & Organs.
